texto: Server improvements to reduce short freezes: backups and launcher downloads no longer pause the game for everyone, and entering busy towns like the Angel Lyceum is faster.

Please update to version 0.0.0.89 from AngelsLauncher. Open your pet info panel and press Evolve to see its whole evolution tree: every form with its picture, level, type, stats and abilities. Click the form you want and press Evolve: your pet grows that way when it has the level (15 / 35 / 55) and the Medium or Advanced Blood Certificate.

Please update to version 0.0.0.86 from AngelsLauncher. A new pet line has arrived: the Abyss Egg hatches into Abyss Cub at level 15, becomes Abyss Fiend with a Medium Blood Certificate (level 35) and Abyss Lord with an Advanced Blood Certificate (level 55). Each stage has its own colors and size.

Shining Charm no longer always works. Its chance is 10% at level I, 20% at II, 30% at III, 40% at IV and 50% at V, a bit lower against monsters above your level and a bit higher (up to +10%) against weaker ones. If it fails, the mana is spent and the monster attacks you.

titulo: Charm: one monster at a time
texto: You can only have one charmed monster at a time. Charming a new one releases the previous one, which becomes a normal monster again.

Please update to version 0.0.0.82 from AngelsLauncher. The Prop and Backpack windows have a new Sort button in their title bar, next to the lock: it sorts your items by category and stacks them together. Pets stay where they are. Maple Mark now shows the recorded place in its tooltip (Sign).
ShadowBlade (Assassin) basic attacks now use their proper attack animation.

Maple Mark works again: right click it to record your current position, then right click it again to travel there. Each travel uses one Maple Teleportation Scroll; if you have none, it uses one Maple Mark instead.

A completed treasure map (10/10 pieces) now shows where the treasure is: open the Quest Log, TreMap tab, to see the place marked on the map. Walk to that spot to dig it up and get the reward; the map then starts again at 0/10. The level of the Map Pieces you use decides how rich the treasure is. The Delete button clears the map.

Please update to version 0.0.0.80 from AngelsLauncher. The Exchange lists (Event Overview > Exchange: Winter Holiday PD, Ride and Robots, Enhanced Pestle and Ride Feed, and other exchanges) show all their items again.

Monsters charmed with Shining Charm now only use basic attacks, with their normal damage. Skill levels of ShadowBlade can no longer go above your character level. Fixed a colored ring that could stay under your character after traveling to another map.
Please update to version 0.0.0.79 from AngelsLauncher: the quick bar now shows letters too when you assign them to a slot. City Angels send their citizens back to the Angel Lyceum again.
Please update to version 0.0.0.78 from AngelsLauncher. The AOF tab of the System window now has a clean background that follows your window color.

titulo: Update 0.0.0.77: rebind your quick bar keys
texto: Please update to version 0.0.0.77 from AngelsLauncher (it also updates the game). New AOF tab in the System window (Esc): chat is now closed until you press Enter; type your message and press Enter again to send it and close the chat (Esc closes it too). With Rebind you can assign any key to each quick bar slot, including numbers and letters, and they are saved on your PC. The quick bar now shows the key of each slot.

Sneak now really hides the Assassin: while it lasts you become almost transparent, without name or health bar, and other players cannot select you. Attacking with anything other than an assassination technique, or the end of the effect, makes you visible again.

titulo: Skills, armor and Totem War souls
texto: In Totem War, a soul can now click the totem of its own faction to revive there. Mage skills (Life, Wraith, Chaos, Earth) can only be used with their skill equipped. When you change a skill at the Skill Angel (for example Mantle to Vestment or Garment), the gear the new skill does not allow goes back to your bag; if your bag has no room, the change is cancelled.

Please update to version 0.0.0.71 from the launcher. The Login Rewarder exchange no longer offers the Olympic Heart, Goddess Statue (7-Day), Angel Power Necklace (7 days) or Super Purple Potion, and the 3x EXP, 3x Skill EXP and 3x Pet EXP Chocolates now give 1 chocolate instead of 8. Less lag right after a server restart.

titulo: Revival, Totem War souls and Power Shield
texto: Revival skills now work: the effect lands on the dead player and revives them where they are, with the health of the skill. In Totem War, a soul that walks next to its own faction totem revives there. Power Shield shows its bubble again while it lasts. Olly, Ozzy and the Blessing Angel are no longer in Angel Lyceum.

Please update to version 0.0.0.70 from the launcher. Totem War totems now go up to level 5 at most, with their LEVEL effect when they go up (levels 2 to 5) and when they go down (levels 4 to 1). The yellow number under K.O. now shows the credits you earned in the war. When the war ends, the PvP rings and the K.O. counter are cleared, and they no longer show on Totem War maps when there is no war. The Healer no longer sells Fusion Potions, Poke Eggs, hammers or Shapeshifting Slime.

Skill side effects now work in PvP too, with each skill's own chance, duration and interval: burns, poisons and bleeds (they never kill), stun, freeze, root and slow. Totem War kills now give credits based on the victim's level: x5 for their first death in the war, x2 after that. The totem shows its new level when it goes up or down. Power Shield now shows its blue bubble while it lasts. At the max level (60) quests and rewards no longer give experience.

Destroying a totem of level 2 or higher now only lowers it one level, and it comes back with the full health of that level. Only a level 1 totem gives the territory. The totem now shows the LEVEL UP effect when its level changes. Sitting down no longer looks like dying to other players.

Everyone now sees the same totem level, and it updates as soon as it levels up during the war. A totem that levels up during the war also gets the health of its new level. Pets and summons no longer attack the totem of their own faction or league.
Using a skill no longer plays a basic attack too, for every class: the skill is your attack for that turn. After a skill, basic attacks only start again when you click the monster.

Assassins no longer receive the production robot when choosing their class, their basic attack uses the right animation, and their skills no longer play a basic attack too. Cupid now saves your revival point correctly. Choosing a name that is already taken now tells you so.

New custom event system on the server: maps can now have events when you enter them, at scheduled times or after hunting, with rewards, experience, portals, monster invasions and server-wide announcements. Stay tuned for the first ones!
NPCs that have a quest for you now show [!] before their name. All monsters now hit 50% harder.
Monsters now use their own spells and skills in combat, like the Phoenix Fire of the Evil Fire Elf, also against your pets and summons. Watch out!
Field bosses now take 20 minutes to come back after they die.
Quests now give 10% of the experience they used to give. The quest window still shows the old amount.
Santa Clausula hits harder now (+500 attack and +500 magic attack), and you can now see his Cross Chop and Revolving Swords.

Power Shield now works: while it lasts, the damage you take is paid with MP instead of HP, up to its limit (1350 to 3000 damage depending on the level). Silence cannot be used on you while it is active.

Expression Code cards (Train, Wait, Laugh, Yawn, Love...) now unlock a new expression at the end of the Emotes window, as their description says. If you used a Laugh card before, it is now in your window.

City Angels only send their own citizens to the Angel Lyceum. The Trade Routes ring no longer stays on your character after delivering. Less lag right after a server restart and the first time some features are used. Treasure map: any 10 Map Pieces complete it, of any level, and repeated pieces count too.

New small cargo at the Guild Clerk: Herb (50,000), Wool (100,000), Spice (200,000), Wine (300,000) and Tea Cargo (400,000), 15 minutes each: Traders get back double what they invested. Thieves now get from the Fence what the Trader invested. Carrying cargo now slows you down 30% (was 50%). Everyone is told when someone buys a cargo. Hunters in a Trader's party now show the ring too. Update the client (0.0.0.69) from the launcher.

Talk to the Guild Clerk in any city (in Aurora City, by the market at 242,199) and become a Trader, Hunter or Thief (you can quit and take the same job back anytime; switching to another job takes 7 days). Traders buy Grain, Silk or Gem Cargo and ride it to another city for profit; Hunters in their party escort them and share a reward. Thieves hunt for traders outside the cities, steal the cargo and sell it to a Fence. Everyone who delivers also gets an exchange voucher. While you carry cargo, a countdown icon shows the time left (and you get reminders at 10, 5 and 1 minute). Your job stays after logging out; quit it at the Guild Clerk. Dropped cargo is visible on the ground: click it (within 3 steps, riding a mount) to pick it up. Cargo orders now survive server restarts (the timer pauses while the server is down).

Gem Gauge now removes the gem from the last hole (the hole stays open). Angels GO! (Superwing) can no longer be used while carrying Trade Routes cargo. Trade Routes PvP: whoever carries cargo (and their escort) can now attack the players who can attack them, and they can be selected right away. Less lag when players log in. While a cargo is in dispute (carried or dropped on the ground), Thieves and the Trader's party can keep fighting on that map. Players killed in PvP now fall for everyone. Trade Routes PvP: Thieves can now select the Trader again after the Trader dies and comes back to the map while the cargo is on the ground, and two players carrying cargo can target each other (no more shared team ring). Trade Routes PvP rings are back: Thieves and the Trader's side now show rings of different colors, so you can see who you are fighting.

Level 32 and 60 mage AoE (Angel's Light, Aurora Trap, Strong Acid Rain, Hell Flame, Thunder Scope, Fire Trap, Lull Thorn, Canker Moss) now cast in 1 second. Life, Wraith, Chaos and Earth only level up with spells of their own branch. Dark Cavern: black minimap, monsters and boss hit twice as hard and chase you across the whole map.

Pets that reach 0 HP now die and must be revived at the Pet Expert (Pet Revival). Pet breeding: choose one option each time your pet levels up. Pet skills now deal their damage correctly. Pet Feed (satiation over 100) makes your pet attack 25% faster and its bonus shows in the bag tooltip.

Lv1-60 gear sells to NPC shops for 100-6,000 gold depending on its level. Lucky Bags give Double Exp Card, Double Skill Exp Card, Ride Feed and hammers one at a time. Fixed the colored ring that sometimes appeared on players after changing maps.
Monsters now drop Gear Gacha of their level: weapons, cape, accessory, gems and Light/Heavy/Robe armor, with the official odds (normal 22.8%, Quality 2%, the best 0.2%).
We moved to a new server in America. Visit aoforever.tech (English/Spanish) to create your account and use My account: characters, password and the events calendar.
Faction change at the Census Angel (Lyceum). Summons no longer walk through walls, Dense Forest portals no longer send you back and the minimap shows one dot per NPC.
